{{Quote|What about sea monsters?''"<br />"''Well that's why we'll go swimming on Corellia. There aren't any sea monsters there. They keep all of ''them'' on Selonia, because the oceans are much bigger there.|Anakin Solo and Han Solo|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />}}
'''Sea monsters''' were a type of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] creatures that lived in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]]. There were no sea monsters on the neighboring world of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] because its oceans were much smaller than Selonia's.<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />

In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] told [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] that they could swim at the [[Gold Beaches/Legends|Gold Beaches]] of Corellia during a [[Solo family/Legends|family]] trip to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. His youngest son, [[Anakin Solo]], was dubious of swimming due to a concern that there would be sea monsters at the [[Beach/Legends|beaches]], but Han assured him that all the sea monsters were on Selonia.<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sea monsters were first mentioned in the [[1995]] novel ''[[Ambush at Corellia]]'', written by [[Roger MacBride Allen]].<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />
